Why the taxes are so low

Three rules, one result.

Proposition 13 (1978): land owned since before 1975 is still valued from its 1975 figure plus small annual increases. Member-owned clubs almost never sell.

The 1960 golf-course rule: nonprofit courses of ten acres or more are assessed on their use as golf courses.

Los Angeles Country Club v. Pope (1985): the clubs get the benefit of both rules at once.
